name: coding_context_coding_mode
notes: PORT FIX APPLIED: coding_ctx_mode previously read a top-level 'coding_mode' key and returned 'default'; it now reads agent.coding_context (LIVE nesting), strip()s and lowercases the raw value, and normalizes through LIVE's focus/on/off ladders. config==NULL maps to the empty-config path ('auto') since the readonly config load is not harnessable.
